profile_text.body:
EHang Holdings Ltd is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou, China, and trades on NASDAQ under the ticker EH. Its website describes the company as an autonomous aerial vehicle technology platform company focused on urban air mobility. The company says its mission is to make safe, autonomous and eco-friendly air mobility accessible to everyone.

The site lists product and solution areas including passenger transportation, logistics, emergency rescue, aerial media, and infrastructure solutions. EHang says it provides AAV products and commercial solutions for urban air mobility, smart city management, and aerial media. The company describes itself as a forerunner of AAV technologies and commercial solutions in the global urban air mobility industry. SEC records identify the company by CIK number 0001759783.
